_about: The study tutor as a specialist the runner consults before a lane starts (Chuen, 5 Nov 2026: 'treat Don like a professional opinion on task'). Orchestra's own data file, read by orchestra/consult.py on every use: orchestra/config.json is pinned by tests and holds limits, this holds the consult. ORCHESTRA_CONSULT_FILE points at another copy for tests. Advisory throughout: a consult that fails, times out or gives low confidence never stops a task and never blocks a merge.
_enabled: The switch. false: no task is consulted, nothing else changes.
name: don
_name: The agent key a task header names (Consult: don). The display name is read from name_file[name_key] (tutor.json 'name') so the tutor is named in one place; this key is the fallback.
_header: A task whose header line '<header>: <name>' names the tutor is consulted whatever its text says.
_path_patterns: Case-insensitive regexes against the task file's text: a task that names the study tooling as a file or folder (study_brief.py, study_mode.json, tutor/, learner\) is consulted too. The bare words are not enough: 'the tutor' in a title is not a file. Edit here, not in code.
_command: Run in the main checkout. {python} is the repo venv (python above), else the runner's own interpreter; {question} is the rendered question. The last JSON object line of stdout is the opinion (python -m tutor consult --json). Exit 1 = the tutor had no grounded answer: logged, no note written. The timeout covers a hand-off to Claude for a hard topic (delegate.py), which can take minutes.
prompt_line:
## {name}'s opinion
{name}, the study tutor, was asked about this task before you started; the opinion is in `{file}` (confidence: {confidence}). Read it. Weigh it as a subject expert's view: informed by Chuen's own lecture notes, advisory, never an override. Where you go against it, say so in one line under ODD.
reviewer_section:
{text}
(Advisory: the tutor's view of the subject matter, for context only. It is never a reason to block, and going against it is not a reason to block.)
reviewer_none: (none: the tutor was not consulted for this task)
log: CONSULT {slug}: {name} asked ({why}) -> {confidence} confidence by {who} after {seconds}s; {file} written
log_failed: CONSULT {slug}: {name} could not answer ({why}); the lane runs without it
